race.comment: YAPPER (7) resumes today without a trial, though he worked through the grades nicely in his debut campaign, testing the waters in the Listed Challenge Stakes two starts back. His efforts here early in the prep were super and with a touch of luck from the draw, he can return with a bang. ARCHENEMY (1) comes back from Saturday company where he wasn't disgraced before the break, finishing midfield after being well back in the run. The inside draw can see him play a role in the finish with Yuill's booking a good push for his chances. LEONARDO DA GREY (6) was unlucky not to win one last time in work and gets the pacifiers back on today. Likely to be in the second half of the field, but he can storm over the top to score without surprising. IN SITU (2) didn't come up last campaign but resumes in an easier race today, over a track and trip where he's unbeaten. Can play a leading role. TRULY GALLANT (3) won't be far away first-up.
